text:
Sam K: heads-up — saw a regression in TP all-reduce after the kernel-selector tweak landed today. 8-GPU runs for model-x: small-frag msgs (8–32KB) latency up ~2.3x and tail p95 up ~1.9x. flame link: https://internal/fg/1768872210 :eyes:
Jess L: ugh. which change exactly? i saw a commit that made kernel autoswitch prefer the new smallfrag kernel by default. commit: sha1 f2a9c3d
Sam K: yep that one. baseline (before) avg reduce time ~14ms, after ~33ms for those msg sizes. full profile attached to the run: /perf/runs/1768872210/profile.pb
Omar R: do we have NCCL traces? this smells like ring vs tree tradeoff + fragmentation. if the new kernel increases message chunking, we might be paying extra all-reduce hops
Sam K: copied relevant lines from perf dump:
```
[reduce_op] size=16384  kernel=new_smallfrag  total_ms=33.2  comm_ms=18.6  compute_ms=12.4  extra_hops=1
[reduce_op] size=65536  kernel=old_batch      total_ms=12.8  comm_ms=6.2   compute_ms=5.6
```
Jess L: interesting — comm_ms is the big changer. could be that new kernel pushes different packet boundaries leading NCCL to pick ring fallback instead of tree. ring is cheaper for large msgs, tree better at short-critical paths depending on topology.
Nina P: I ran nccl topo logs for the same job, it shows all nodes were on mixed NVLink/PCIe links. on that topology, tree algo was previously winning for 8-32KB due to fewer hops.
Sam K: hypothesis: kernel selector now splits tensors into slightly different chunk boundary (stride alignment) making the effective NCCL msgsize fall into ring's heuristic. ring -> more serialized handshake for many small chunks.
Omar R: can we repro quickly by forcing NCCL algorithm? try export NCCL_ALGO=tree and re-run the micro-bench. also toggle REDWOOD_KERNEL_ALIGN=legacy to force old boundary.
Sam K: running quick micro-bench now on staging-8 with both toggles. cmd i used:
```
REDWOOD_KERNEL_ALIGN=legacy NCCL_ALGO=tree python perf/tests/tp_allreduce_micro.py --gpus 8 --msgsize 16384 --iters 200
```
infra-bot: started job perf-1768872210-repro on staging-8 (jid=pf-8812). logs: https://internal/jobs/pf-8812
Sam K: first pass numbers: legacy-align + tree = total ~15ms (back to baseline). new-align + default_nccl = 33ms. switching NCCL_ALGO=tree with new-align yields ~17ms (mostly comm_ms down).
Jess L: solid repro. so two levers: revert kernel-align change or add kernel->nccl heuristic mapping so selector keeps chunk boundaries that favor tree when topology suggests it.
Omar R: agreeing with heuristic mapping. we should also add a quick metric in profiler: emit "effective_nccl_msgsize" and selected_nccl_algo so we can alert when selector shifts effective msgsize across a decision boundary.
Nina P: I'll open a small RFC for kernel selector fallback rules + add the profiler metric. cc @Sam K for sample logs and comm_ms threshold.
Sam K: created minimal issue: https://internal/issue/RED-1129 with perf numbers and repro steps. putting a canary rollback of the kernel-align change on the stack until we have a mapping.
deploy-bot: canary rollback queued for ksvc=kernel-selector v2 -> will deploy to canary in ~8m.
Jess L: thanks. also let's add an automated micro-bench in CI for 8/16/32KB msg sizes to catch future misroutes. small PR incoming. :thumbsup:
